Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.controller

Class HouseholdController

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.controller.HouseholdController
public class HouseholdController extends Object
US-08 (create a household), US-09 (join a household) and US-10 (delete a household) - plus a minimal read of the resulting household once the user has one. Member management (US-11+) is out of scope here.
